page.layout: One blank leaf; no printed text blocks. Only paper, a small ink spot on the left-centre, and the book's binding/edge at the right.
page.notes: Blank page: no printed text, no running head, no page number, no catchword or signature. The dark spot in the left-centre is a stain or ink blot, not text. The strip at the right edge is the binding and the neighbouring page edge, not printed matter.
